_comment: Runtime AI configuration. Edit this file after deployment and refresh the page - no rebuild needed. auth.type: "none" (no auth) | "user" (credential entered in the UI) | "fixed" (apiKey below) | "dsp" (fetch a token from tokenUrl first, then use it to call the AI endpoint). In dsp mode, auth.dsp.tokenBody supports {{username}} / {{password}} / {{apiKey}} / custom placeholders, which are filled from the UI settings panel and sent to tokenUrl. Example below uses username/password authentication (OAuth2 password grant). For client-credentials instead, use {"clientId":"...","clientSecret":"...","grantType":"client_credentials"}.
